justification: Both are shallow relief carvings in warm-toned stone that use a horizontal band of small repeated units to divide the field, and both place profile-viewed figures against a flat ground. But A is an extended single-register frieze of evenly spaced, naturalistically draped human processional figures on a long wall, while B is a free-standing block with stacked, irregularly composed schematic animals and abstract signs in a much blunter, rounded carving manner.
